title: External File Storage: reject "." and ".." path segments
summary: External File Storage now rejects path segments that are purely "." or ".." to prevent directory traversal attacks, while allowing dots within file or folder names.
key_points: CheckPath validation rejects "." and ".." as complete path segments across all external storage operations
Prevents directory traversal vulnerabilities where connectors like SharePoint would resolve relative segments
Dots inside names like "v1..2.pdf" or "..hidden" remain valid
Public API behavior change: callers passing relative paths now receive an error instead of passing to the connector
No internal callers in the repository use relative paths; external extensions must normalize paths
quote: Rejects a path when a whole segment is "." or "..", with a clear error.
